facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year. Applications for a specific program or university are made according to the respective announcement on the internet.

There are separate application procedures for the European and worldwide programs. The announcement and selection for the worldwide programs take place before the selection for the European programs. If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, applying for the European exchange under the Erasmus+ program is possible without restriction.

The announcements and selection for the worldwide and European exchange take place simultaneously. Announcements will be published at the end of October with an application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
